provenance: Names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase / PSNProfiles and carried in the bounty kit (18 Nov 2026). Guides are written for this entry from the official descriptions and the cited launch guides. Methods for five hidden trophies were still unconfirmed at launch (PowerPyx) and are marked so.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is no shortcut. The platinum is the reward for finishing everything below: the story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours, most of it on the road to 100% completion.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of Chapter 1 and unlocks automatically as the story starts — just play through the opening until the mission-complete screen. Nothing to prepare; it cannot be missed.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by playing its main missions in order. Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the one thing in the game that may not come back.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. It follows straight from Chapter 1 — main missions only, nothing optional needed. Both protagonists become playable here, which opens most of the map's activities, so start scanning vehicles and animals with the WAiNK app as you travel.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Keep following the main-mission thread; chapter trophies need no side content. Use the travel time between missions to knock out drone races, stunts and WAiNK scans on the way.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the penultimate chapter. Finish its final mission and the trophy pops. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — there is no mission replay, and a spare save is cheap insurance before the finale.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Chapter 5. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save from before it if you want to revisit the ending. Free-roam continues after the credits, and everything left over can be finished there.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It appears in the normal mission flow — play it when it shows up. Story mission trophies cannot be missed: the mission stays available until you play it.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are linear — follow the objectives to the end and the trophy pops on completion. Go in with full health and ammo; there is nothing to prepare in advance.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks in the normal mission order — play it when it appears and the trophy follows on completion.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. A mission trophy like the rest — it unlocks in the mission flow and pops when the mission ends.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Follow the mission markers through the takedown; the trophy pops when the mission completes.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The name promises a big set-piece, so go in stocked — full health, armour and ammo — and follow the objectives to the end.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion — the hardest trophy, by PowerPyx. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. It covers the story, 100 optional tasks, robberies, fencing totals, collectibles, activities and scanning — roughly 60% of true completion by PowerPyx's estimate. Nothing on the checklist is missable; finish it in free-roam after the credits, using this guide's roadmap stage 5.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: jumps, airtime, near-misses and other driving feats. The game tracks unique stunts, so vary your driving — ramp jumps, long airtime, near misses in traffic, stunt jumps around Leonida. Grind them during free-roam drives between other goals; each new stunt type counts toward the 250.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, bowling, drone races, meditation, hunting and more. Sample one of each — the trophy is about breadth, not mastery — and tick them off in this guide's checklist as you go.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold needs speed and accuracy: learn each course's target layout, use a steady weapon with low recoil, and replay a course until the gold time and score land. There is no pressure outside the course itself, so take the 42 one at a time.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's gates, cut corners where the course allows, and use boost pads. Each location's win is tracked separately, so work through them one by one.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street races, off-road, boat and air races all qualify — enter race events from the map and win each one once. Repeats don't add to the count, so keep picking events you haven't won yet.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and take his challenge: cast where the fish shadow is, keep the tension in the green, and reel steadily. Losing costs nothing — challenge him again until you win.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into any arcade and finish one full game — any cabinet counts. Pick the shortest game if you just want the trophy, then move on.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's mission strand ends with a finale — play through his missions in order until the last one completes. Stranger strands are marked on the map with their icons.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as Andy's: follow Kenton's strand to its finale, mission by mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its finale — the last mission in his chain.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map; finish 8 full strands (each strand is several missions). There are more strands than needed, so pick the shortest ones first. A few optional missions can disappear over time, but there are far more than 8 strands, so nothing here blocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its finale.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand to its finale.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. The first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — the morning after 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. Do it before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY (PowerPyx, GTABase): the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1. The morning after the mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate — then follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a 'Meditation Spot' like the rest, so it is unconfirmed whether it is required — doing it is the safe choice. The other 17 spots are marked on the map and can be done any time, before or after the story.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret marks a unique animal to hunt — follow his strand, track the animal (look for tracks and study it through the binoculars), and take the shot cleanly. Unique animals appear once, so save before the hunt in case the shot goes wrong.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, houses and out in the world. Each set needs every card in it; use the WAiNK app to scan unfamiliar spots and the in-game collection menu to see which cards you are missing, then hunt the gaps.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app on your phone and scan 100 different locations, vehicles and animals. Scan everything unfamiliar as you travel — the counter climbs fast if you scan on every trip — and it feeds the 100% checklist too. You only need 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned for 100%, so the 100 WAiNK scans come naturally.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small goals in the Progress menu (stunts, driving feats, combat and more). 70 of the 80 count toward 100%, so this pops naturally on the road to A Long Road — check the menu to see which are closest to done and finish those first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner (rob a store, then fight back), then break line of sight: lose the cops in alleys, switch cars, or hide until the stars drain. Your partner must be with you when the stars clear.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Rob a shop with your partner, keep the heat (don't lose the cops), and hit two more shops in a row before it drops. Plan a route with three close shops and a fast car, and keep the robberies quick.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or scan 100 different vehicles — the WAiNK app counts scans toward discovery, and every new model you sit in counts. Variety beats repetition: try cars, bikes, boats and aircraft across the map, and scan each new one you meet.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus slows time — trigger it in a firefight with at least 5 enemies close together and line up headshots while time is slow. Missions with groups of enemies are the easiest place to set it up.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. Get to the airport and leave in a way it didn't schedule — steal a plane or a service vehicle and take off from the runway. Expect a wanted level; the trophy pops once you are airborne and clear of the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — the Rhinos are tanks. Get one, or get in front of one, and make the tank the center of the chaos: provoke a heavy response or hijack a Rhino during a military encounter and survive the heat. The trophy is about the Rhino, so engage it head-on.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case a jewelry store, go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses, no cameras spotting you. Move at night, take the goods and leave before anyone notices; if you are spotted, leave and try another store.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Five vault robberies, each followed by a clean escape — the escape is what counts, not just the robbery. Plan each one: a fast getaway car, a route out of the city, and enough firepower to hold off the response.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open, grab the cash and escape before the response arrives. Trucks run set routes — watch one first, then hit it where the road is quiet and the getaway is clear.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The game tracks which areas you have set foot in — drive the highways, fly over the islands and walk the beaches. WAiNK scans help you find areas you have missed; check the map for gaps and visit them.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang's turf is marked by its activity — hit one operation per gang and work through all nine. The operations repeat, so if one goes wrong, try another spot for the same gang.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view, and order a cocktail. Method not yet confirmed at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy's unlock as not yet known; the description points at a specific beachfront spot, so try the Ocean Beach bars first and check back as guides update.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's front and out the other side. Method not yet confirmed at launch (PowerPyx lists it as not yet known); any big showroom should do — go fast, aim for the glass, and don't stop.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Find that bowling alley and bowl a full game — follow through on the throw, as the description hints. Any completed game at that alley counts.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague, and PowerPyx doesn't pin the method down yet — it is a partnership moment. Play partner missions and side activities with your partner; shared activities and high-wanted escapes together are the likely trigger, so keep doing things as a pair.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Keep choosing: dialogue options, mission approaches and side decisions all feed the in-game counter that tracks your choices. There is no wrong choice for the trophy — the count climbs as you play, so it pops naturally over a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Succeed on a second try — fail something, then do it again and succeed. Method not yet confirmed at launch (PowerPyx lists it as not yet known); the natural reading is retrying a failed activity or mission objective and passing on the second attempt, so don't reload a save after a failure — retry instead.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange. Leonida hides weird events — odd encounters, strange places, things that don't belong. Method not yet confirmed at launch (PowerPyx); explore odd corners of the map at night and the trophy finds you.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar melee weapon. Method not yet confirmed at launch (PowerPyx); line up a slow pass, swing, and connect.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — fence them through your contacts, a cut at a time, until $250,000 is clean. It counts toward 100% too, so launder as you rob instead of saving it all for the end.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, cars and upgrades — all shop spending counts, and the total is cumulative. Big purchases (cars, properties) get you there fastest; this pops naturally while buying gear for the rest of the list.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Each is a separate purchase from the property menu across Leonida. You need the cash first, so this is a late-game buy — save it for after the story, when the money from robberies and fencing is in.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register vehicles you own or find — 10 registrations total. Register each new car you pick up and the counter climbs on its own.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
